title: Liquid Experience
description: Turns your experience into liquid! If you've ever wanted a way to store your experience without needing to go through many tech mod steps, this is for you! Downloads "Fluidic Tanks" alongside this mod.
body:
Turns your experience into liquid! If you've ever wanted a way to store your experience without needing to go through many tech mod steps, this is for you! Downloads "Fluidic Tanks" alongside this mod.



Store your raw XP for use later! This mod has a flat exchange rate of XP so you'll never lose any of it transfering between player and storage!



**Liquid Experience** - Each bucket of liquid experience holds 27 XP points. 10 buckets will get you about 13 levels. If you put the liquid experience into a bucket, it can be placed and you can collect 27 XP straight from the source block. 



**Player Experience Drain** - When stood on, slowly drains the player of their XP into the connected fluid tank. Has multiple tiers which increase the draining rate doubled with each tier. 



**Experience Repositry** - A block that has to be placed on a fluid tank containing XP. 

1 Left click = Gain 1 level

1 Crouch + left click = Gain 10 levels

1 Right click = Deposit 1 level

1 Crouch + right click = Deposit 10 levels



**Fluidic Tanks **

The faucet from Fluidic Tanks can be used to dispense XP orbs when powered. Fluidic Tanks is also installed alongside Liquid Experience as the default container for liquid experience.

**Apothic Enchanting**

When a fluid tank is placed under an enchanting table, it adds more Eterna, Quanta, and Arcana with the more buckets added. +2 Eterna per 1 bucket, +2 Quanta per 10 buckets, +1 Arcana per 25 buckets.
